evaluation: fable-baseline-transformer-v2 checkpoint, greedy (argmax) decoding, FINAL checkpoint only, no selection, scored on the 25 frozen v3 DEVELOPMENT panel cells
pair_rule: a pair cell scores a unit only when BOTH twins are correct (fable_baseline_transformer.aggregate, unchanged)
panel_files_verified: V3.load_panels re-hashed every cell file and forbidden-semantics.json against manifest.json
question: does a checkpoint that fits 1-3 hops at 6 people LENGTH-GENERALISE?
strict_path: every emitted token equals the gold steps sequence and END is emitted immediately after the answer

trained_ranges.note: a steps output for k hops is k+1 tokens and a k-hop question is k+3 tokens; the row grammar (and so the 10-token longest row) is the same in training and in the panels, so only the question and the output grow

unscorable_rule: a cell whose prompt or output would CLAMP against a fixed position table is not decoded at all; it records unscorable_reason and counts as 0 passed
